principles: Review and change events are append-only records; prior events are never overwritten.
Reviewer role is sufficient where publishing personal identity is unnecessary.
Source access date, review date and change date are distinct.
Technical validation, source verification, domain review, computability and custodian approval are independent states.
A provenance event never changes official wording silently and never implies source-custodian approval.

publicReviewerPolicy.namedReviewersRequire: Documented consent and a legitimate public accountability need
